pages.rationale: The page is the frame: same two cards (Keys table with action/key/where columns and the green 'no conflicts' badge; Adjudication behaviour with six rows), same rail, same lede, same locked 'set in Vocabulary' links, same footer note plus 'Export preferences', same 'Reset page to defaults'. All eight manifest states reach cleanly with no console or page errors: conflict deep link, capture (focus lands on the capture span, the next key rebinds), locked-owner conflict on a verdict key, locked-owner conflict on a class key, Ctrl K chord conflict against 'search' with the global search panel suppressed, a free chord (Ctrl J) binding as one cap, behaviour toggles, reset confirm, and the leave guard both on and off. All four previous P0/P1 findings verify as fixed. Two small visual differences remain against the frame (the locked 'undo reverses a whole batch' toggle reads washed-out rather than the frame's solid green, and the two Vocabulary-owned rows lack the frame's grey row fill), which is what keeps this off 10.

findings.title: prev fixed: key capture does not take focus
findings.detail: Clicking the Space cell of 'skip without writing' puts document.activeElement on SPAN|capture-skip; the very next press of q rebinds the row to Q with the capture cell gone. No second click needed.

findings.title: prev fixed: moving a key off a locked verdict bound it twice
findings.detail: Capturing S on 'mark viewport reviewed' shows 'S is bound to “verdicts S · I · N · A · U”. A key does one thing.', the Vocabulary sentence, Open Vocabulary, 'Move S here' disabled, a red '1 conflict' badge, and the row keeps R.

findings.title: prev fixed: 'confirm before leaving unsaved settings' toggle had no effect
findings.detail: With the toggle on, editing Export and clicking About holds at #/settings/export with 'Leave with 1 unsaved change?' and 'from Keyboard & behaviour · confirm before leaving unsaved settings (turn it off there to leave without asking)'. With it off, the same sequence lands on #/settings/about and raises '1 unsaved change left on Export · nothing was written'.

findings.title: prev fixed: rebinding onto a class key (1-9) was accepted with 'no conflicts'
findings.detail: Pressing 3 into the skip capture cell now raises the same locked-owner conflict as S: red '1 conflict', '3 is bound to “classes”. A key does one thing.', the Vocabulary sentence, Open Vocabulary, 'Move 3 here' disabled, and the row keeps its old key.

findings.title: prev fixed: Ctrl K during capture bound bare 'K' and opened the search panel
findings.detail: Ctrl K in an open capture cell now composes the chord and raises 'Ctrl K is bound to “search”. A key does one thing.' with a red badge; no [data-testid=settings-search] panel opens. A free chord (Ctrl J) binds as the single cap 'Ctrl J'.

findings.title: Locked 'undo reverses a whole batch' toggle reads as off
findings.detail: The frame draws this locked row as a solid green toggle with the knob right and a lock icon beside it, matching the other 'on' toggles. The app draws a pale mint track with a lock glyph filling the left half and a white knob, so at a glance it reads closer to off/disabled than to the frame's clearly-on enforced rule (the markup does carry class 'on' and aria-label 'on · enforced').

findings.title: Vocabulary-owned rows lack the frame's grey row fill
findings.detail: In the frame the 'verdicts S · I · N · A · U' and 'classes' rows sit on a light grey band with their action labels in normal dark mono. The app leaves both rows on white and instead greys the label text, so the 'these two are owned elsewhere' grouping is weaker than the frame's.
